subject: [video] lead ruling: level_idc by Table A-1 limits (WP10 is right)
body: n2avc.h's level line is shorthand; the rule is: the first of (30: MaxFS 1620, MaxMBPS 40500), (31: 3600, 108000), (40: 8192, 245760), (42: 8704, 522240), (51: 36864, 983040) with mb_w*mb_h <= MaxFS and mb_w*mb_h*fps <= MaxMBPS (fps = fps_num/fps_den, compare as integers: mbs*fps_num <= MaxMBPS*fps_den). 640x480@30 and 176x144@30 are level 30. WP03: make pick_level do exactly this; nothing above 51 -> N2AVC_E_ARGUMENT. check_h264's expectation stands.
